Yes
Audio script — نص التسجيل
1. Mr. Frog — Mr. Frog likes rain. He jumps and jumps. Mr. Frog sees a puddle. One, two, three, jump! “I like rain!”
2. The Bananas — Monkey is hungry. She wants bananas. Monkey climbs a big tree. She finds three bananas.
3. Bird and the Books — Bird likes to read. Bird reads at home. He has books about planes. He has books about the weather.

page 9. B. Listen to the story Three Friends. What is it about? Choose the correct picture. Three Friends. I like this farm, says Dan. Look, there's a cow. It isn't a cow, says Jane. It's a sheep. They go to the water. Look, it's a duck, says Dan. They go to a tree. What do they see? It's a monkey, says Jane. The monkey jumps. It isn't a monkey, says Dan. It's Tom.
Three Friends
Dan I like this farm. Look, there’s a cow!
Jane It isn’t a cow. It’s a sheep.
Narrator They go to the water.
Dan Look, it’s a duck!
Narrator They go to a tree. What do they see?
Jane It’s a monkey!
Narrator The monkey jumps.
Dan It isn’t a monkey. It’s Tom!
What is the story about?
Dan and Jane walk on a farm. They see a sheep, a duck, and a monkey. The monkey is not a monkey — it is their friend Tom!
